title: Indonesia Nickel Supply Chain
thesis: Snowflake turns daily site data from a fictional Indonesian nickel supply chain (mine pits, ROM stockpiles, haul roads, barge jetties and smelter feed yards) into on-spec ore KPIs, 7-day disruption-risk scores, ore dwell-time anomalies and grounded AI answers, all on curated dynamic tables.

talking_points: On-spec ore, supply disruptions, rejected loads and ore tonnes moved for 30 sites across 6 nickel regions.
Every KPI is a numerator over a denominator in a curated dynamic table, so it can be traced back to site-day rows and their grade-control lots.
The off-spec chart shows which disruption causes push the most ore outside the Ni grade and moisture target.
tabs.call_out: One governed set of mine-to-port KPIs, traceable to source rows

transition.line: Which sites are likely to cause the next disruption?

talking_points: Snowflake ML classification scores each site's probability of a supply disruption in the next 7 days.
The holdout line shows precision and recall on the most recent labelled days, against the base rate.
Anomaly detection flags ore dwell-time outliers per site, and the forecast projects network-wide ore tonnage for 14 days.
tabs.call_out: Honest, evaluated ML inside the data platform

transition.line: How healthy are the sites behind those risks?

talking_points: Equipment uptime and fleet readiness (excavators, loaders, haul trucks and barges) frame the response capacity.
PM compliance against on-spec ore by site shows where maintenance discipline and grade control move together; it is an association, not proof of cause.
The action memo drafts three prioritised actions from the KPI, disruption, cause and risk tables only.
tabs.call_out: Grounded draft actions, with a human in the loop

transition.line: What happens when a site raises an equipment alarm right now?

talking_points: Live site equipment readings (ore dwell hours, equipment load) land in RAW.LIVE_TELEMETRY, from the simulator or from AWS IoT Core through Snowpipe.
The Snowflake alert logs ALARM readings with an SOP hint and the site's current risk band, then emails the shift supervisor.
tabs.call_out: From alarm to action in one platform

talking_points: The Cortex Agent uses Cortex Analyst over the semantic view for metrics, and Cortex Search over synthetic site SOPs.
Each answer shows the generated SQL and the SOPs it cited.

transition.line: Here is how it is built.

talking_points: Two builds share one core: Snowflake only, or AWS + Snowflake (IoT Core, Bedrock, QuickSight and Amazon Q).
Everything shown is synthetic demo data, rebuilt reproducibly from the repo.
tabs.call_out: One governed core, with an optional AWS edge
